requests.description: Directly eidt the underlying xml of a Chart object within an OpenOpenXml (e.g. Excel, Powerpoint) document. This endpoint will validatate the submitted xml against the [Ecma-376 standard](http://www.ecma-international.org/publications/standards/Ecma-376.htm) prior to saving modification.  Invalid xml will rejected by this endpoint and a (hopefully) helpful error message will be returned.  Use this endpoint for client-side automation of modifications ot Chart objects.
